blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Trial Chamber III of the International Criminal Court (ICC) has convened its status conference today, November 2, 2026, to address procedural matters and trial preparations in the crime against humanity case against former President Rodrigo Duterte. Duterte is not present in the courtroom for the proceedings after the Chamber acknowledged his waiver of the right to be present during today’s proceedings. According to ICC, the ongoing status conference focuses on five central agenda items set out by the judges: (1) Daily sitting schedule, Audio-Visual Link testimony and Rights of Audience; (2) List of Witnesses, number of hours […]...
